segments.an4.274:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.an4.274:1.4: vedanāsu … pe … citte … pe … dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
segments.an4.274:1.5: Rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime cattāro dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti.
